title: AI native trading platform (FREE for early users)
author: AcanthocephalaNo6605
selftext:
I have traded with a lot of disconnected tools like charts, order execution, Claude and Colab. Every tool has its own purpose, but these disconnected tools have 2 problems.

It takes away the ability to act lightning fast.

You don't really have a single context for what all the things you are doing to take one trade

Which basically means that if you want to automate, you need to make the whole system yourself, and as a trader, that is not a trader's thing.  
So we made [while25](https://while25.com/): A programmable trading platform

𝗛𝗲𝗿𝗲'𝘀 𝗵𝗼𝘄 𝗶𝘁 𝘄𝗼𝗿𝗸𝘀:

• **Charts**: All the standard indicators and drawing tools, with several charts side by side. You place and manage orders right on the chart.

• **Python** and **AI**: Custom indicators, strategies and backtests in Python, for any idea you have. The AI assistant reads your charts and positions and writes the code for you. It can't place trades.

• **Orders**: Stocks, ETFs, Crypto, futures and options from one order screen, including multi-leg options. Positions, orders and fills sit in one order book. Every order routes straight to your broker.

• **Risk**: You set a max loss per session, a max order size and a max number of orders. Every order is checked against them before it goes out, whether you sent it or your code did.

• **News** and **fundamentals**: News comes from your Alpaca or Interactive Brokers feed. Fundamentals come from Yahoo Finance. Other data vendors can be plugged in.

𝗚𝗼𝗼𝗱 𝘁𝗼 𝗸𝗻𝗼𝘄:  
Desktop app for Mac and Windows.  
Connects to Interactive Brokers, Alpaca, Zerodha, Upstox, Coinbase and Binance.  
Your funds and broker keys never touch our servers.

How do you handle this? Do you keep your code separate from where you trade? If you want to try it, it's invite-only at [while25.com](https://while25.com/).
